localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: The covered shelter on site has hot and cold running water with sinks, electricity for a small appliance, lights and picnic tables. There is a communal fire pit outside with benches around it. A few vehicles can park on the gravel beside the shelter and the rest of the vehicles park in the adjoining parking area. There is plenty of room for tents to set up on the grass around the shelter and room for games as well. No restriction for large tent setup. Excellent location for weddings, youth groups and family reunions with a trail to the beach which is about a 5-10 minute walk.
Slight slope to driveway. Steep cliff off back of site.
Cliff side. Vehicle can park beside site; walk few steps into site.
